title: Women's Pickleball – Polite Until the Third Shot Tee

seo.title: Pickleball Shirt: Polite Until the Third Shot Tee
seo.description: A funny pickleball shirt for women: a sweet 1960s lady smashes the ball. Relaxed 4.2 oz cotton tee, S-3XL, printed to order. Free size exchange.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

A sweet lady in a sun visor and pearls smiles like she is passing the tea, then smashes the ball hard enough to leave speed lines. This pickleball shirt is for the mom, aunt or Mimi who plays every morning and is perfectly pleasant right up until the third shot.

The print shows a 1960s country-club lady in a pleated skirt and pearls, eyes closed and serene, mid-swing with a wooden paddle as a pickleball streaks past. Faded red, navy, mint green and cream inks, with POLITE UNTIL in red script above and THE THIRD SHOT. in navy slab capitals below.

Wear it to the court, the club tournament or Saturday brunch, and give it to the friend whose dink game is gentle and whose smash is not. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Relaxed fit, crew neck
  • 100% combed, ring-spun cotton (heather colors contain polyester)
  • Fabric weight: 4.2 oz/yd² — lightweight
  • Pre-shrunk, side-seamed construction
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: White, Natural, Heather Stone, Athletic Heather, Pink
  • Blank product sourced from Nicaragua, Honduras, or the US

Questions

What is the Polite Until the Third Shot tee?
It is a women's relaxed tee from Graphic Tees Co. with a vintage country-club lady smashing a pickleball, lettered POLITE UNTIL THE THIRD SHOT. It is printed on a Bella+Canvas 6400 in 4.2 oz cotton, so it stays light and soft on a warm court.

How does the women's relaxed tee fit?
This Graphic Tees Co. tee is a relaxed women's cut in sizes S through 3XL with side seams and a crew neck. Order your usual size for an easy fit or size up for a looser, oversized look. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.

What is it made of and how do I wash it?
The tee is 100% combed, ring-spun cotton, with heather colors blending in some polyester, at a lightweight 4.2 oz. Wash it inside out in cold water with like colors and tumble dry low. That protects the print from fading, so the red and navy inks stay crisp wash after wash.

Is it a good pickleball gift for women?
Yes. It suits the mom, aunt, Mimi or teammate who plays most mornings and jokes about her third-shot drop. It ships from Graphic Tees Co. in a standard tee box, is easy to size with a free exchange, and costs $24.99, so it works for birthdays and club prizes.

Can I get it by Christmas?
Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. pickleball tee should arrive before Christmas. Each shirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.

How does it fit?
It is a relaxed women's cut in S through 3XL. Order your usual size for an easy fit or size up for an oversized look.
